overview: The paper introduces Grasp Any Region (GAR), a multimodal large language model enhanced with an RoI-aligned feature replay technique and mask prompt encoding for precise, context-aware region understanding, along with a multi-stage data pipeline and a comprehensive benchmark (GAR-Bench) for evaluating single and multi-prompt comprehension.

modules.name: Mask Prompt Encoder
modules.description: Input: Binary mask(s); Output: Mask embeddings added to patch embeddings. Processes input binary masks through a convolutional block to generate spatial mask embeddings, which are then zero-initialized and added to the Vision Transformer's patch embeddings to inject spatial guidance.

modules.name: RoI-Aligned Feature Replay
modules.description: Input: Global feature map, binary mask(s); Output: Context-aware local feature vectors. Derives bounding boxes from input masks and applies RoI-Align on the global feature map to extract high-fidelity, context-aware local features for specific regions of interest.

modules.name: GAR Model Core
modules.description: Input: Images, binary mask(s), text instructions; Output: Generated text responses. Integrates the vision encoder, prompt encoding, and RoI-aligned feature replay with the LLM, processing both global image features and local replay features to generate context-aware text descriptions and answers.

modules.name: Fine-Grained Data Pipeline
modules.description: Input: Seed dataset, ImageNet-21K subset images/masks; Output: Validated fine-grained description dataset. Utilizes a seed captioner to generate descriptions for fine-grained categories and an LLM to validate these descriptions against ground-truth categories, producing a refined captioning dataset.

modules.name: Relational Data Pipeline
modules.description: Input: PSG dataset, fine-grained descriptions, scene graph annotations; Output: Relation-aware captions and QA pairs. Uses a fine-grained captioner and an LLM-Merger to synthesize detailed object descriptions and scene graph annotations into relation-aware captions and question-answering pairs for multiple prompts.

modules.name: Multi-Prompt Dataset & Loader
modules.description: Input: Constructed datasets (Seed, Fine-Grained, Relational); Output: Batched tensors of images, masks, and tokenized texts. Custom dataset class handling images, arbitrary numbers of masks, and complex textual instructions, collating them into batches suitable for the GAR model.

modules.name: Training & Optimization Engine
modules.description: Input: GAR model, multi-stage training datasets, configuration; Output: Trained model checkpoints. Manages the supervised fine-tuning workflow, including optimizer scheduling, learning rate decay, and training over the combined dataset.

modules.name: GAR-Bench-VQA Evaluation
modules.description: Input: Model predictions, ground-truth multi-choice QA data; Output: Accuracy scores across perception and reasoning sub-tasks. Evaluates the model's performance on visual question answering, calculating accuracy for perception (color, shape, etc.) and reasoning (position, relation, etc.) categories.

modules.name: GAR-Bench-Cap Evaluation
modules.description: Input: Model generated captions, ground-truth relation captions, images; Output: Caption correctness scores. Assesses captioning quality using an LLM-as-Judge protocol, requiring the model to describe relationships between multiple prompts in simple and detailed formats.

modules.name: External Benchmark Evaluation
modules.description: Input: Trained model, external benchmark datasets (DLC, Ferret, LVIS, etc.); Output: Performance metrics (Similarity, IoU, CIDEr, etc.). Standardized evaluation scripts for detailed localized captioning, recognition, and general multimodal benchmarks to compare against SOTA methods.

modules.name: Video Adaptation Logic
modules.description: Input: Video frames, temporal prompts; Output: Video-level features and predictions. Extends the image-based GAR model to video by uniformly sampling frames, processing them individually, and aggregating features for video captioning and understanding tasks.

modules.name: Ablation Study Manager
modules.description: Input: Model configurations, dataset subsets; Output: Ablation experiment logs and metrics. Framework for running controlled experiments on architectural choices (e.g., global vs. local vs. replay features) and data components to validate their individual contributions.

modules.name: LLM-Judge Infrastructure
modules.description: Input: Text queries, model predictions, optional image crops; Output: Judged scores or rankings. A utility wrapper for interacting with powerful commercial LLMs to judge caption quality or validate dataset annotations, supporting both text-only and multimodal inputs.
